title: 高盛Ian Draiden：日本公司治理改革，为何吸引全球资本？
speaker: Ian Draiden

segments.en: You know those cap that that capital needs a home. So let's take Japan for example, okay. There's this corporate reform that is ongoing. What is that that's more encouraging companies to be to to use their balance sheets more efficiently.
segments.zh: 这些资金需要去处。以日本为例，正在进行的公司治理改革，鼓励企业更有效地利用资产负债表。

segments.en: So we're seeing the vestiges of non core businesses. We're seeing corporate reorganizations. We're seeing unwinding of cross share holdings. There are also succession issues that companies have to deal with and so notwithstanding the rates rise in Japan.
segments.zh: 我们看到非核心业务的剥离、企业重组、交叉持股的解除。还有企业必须处理的继任问题。尽管日本利率上升。

segments.en: Which clearly makes things a little bit more volatile. It feels to me as though that market in particular is going to remain highly attractive to private equity.
segments.zh: 这显然让事情变得更具波动性。但我觉得这个市场对私募权益资本仍将极具吸引力。

segments.en: What do you I mean you mentioned you Japan used to be your home and you're there quite frequently still. What's the biggest change you think that's taking place the biggest changes corporate reform clearly.
segments.zh: 你提到日本曾是你的家，你仍经常去。你认为正在发生的最大变化是什么？最大的变化显然是公司治理改革。
